results.name: model_get_frame_vertex_pointer
results.evidence: Selects base+fixed 'local nodes' offset (+0x88) vs base+stride(+0x24)*frame addressing gated by the same flag test used throughout this cluster (byte@0x3a&1 and DAT_006894b4); result is consumed by FUN_004d4dd0/4f90/51a0/5c00 as the raw vertex-record base for a frame.
results.summary: Computes the address of the raw compressed vertex data for a given animation frame index of the current model part.

results.name: model_vertex_weight_sum
results.evidence: Walks a per-vertex blend-index list (stride 2/3/4 floats selected by a type short at +0x26) accumulating a running weight sum and snapshotting it at a target index (+0x34), writing total and single-entry outputs to the two out-params.
results.summary: Sums per-node blend weights for a vertex and returns both the total and one specific weight component.

results.name: model_region_permutation_enumerate_next
results.evidence: Indexes the model's region array (datum+0x14, stride 0xb4, matching the region array confirmed in FUN_004d6ab0) by a region index, reads a permutation slot (+0x3c/+0x3e), optionally writes a permutation data pointer to an out-param, advances a counter and returns a small state code (0-4) governing further iteration.
results.summary: Advances an iterator over a model region's permutations/markers, optionally returning the current permutation's data pointer and a state code.

results.name: model_node_get_translation
results.evidence: Calls FUN_004d4a80 (the node SQT-transform evaluator) into a large stack buffer, then matrix4x3_from_quaternion, and copies the resulting 3 floats into the caller struct at +0x28/+0x2c/+0x30 -- the same translation offsets used for the canonical model node SQT layout seen elsewhere (FUN_004d7610).
results.summary: Evaluates a node's animated transform and stores its resulting translation into the node/object structure.

results.name: model_animation_get_frame_delta
results.evidence: Calls FUN_004d4a80 twice with adjacent frame indices (in_ECX and in_ECX-1) into two local buffers, then subtracts the resulting x/y/z translation triples and stores the difference via unaff_EBX.
results.summary: Computes the per-frame translation delta (movement) of a node between the current and previous animation frame.

results.name: model_node_evaluate_transform
results.evidence: Builds an array of 8-float SQT node-transform records (rotation quaternion + translation + scale, 0x20-byte stride, matching FUN_004d7610's layout), decompressing raw vertex-format quaternion/translation/scale via FUN_004d6380/FUN_004d6330 or, when animated, via the keyframe interpolators FUN_004d6b60/FUN_004d6cf0/FUN_004d6e80, and falls back to FUN_004d7610 when the object has no override transform.
results.summary: Fills an array of per-node local SQT transforms for a given frame, decoding compressed vertex data or interpolating animation keyframes as needed.

results.name: model_vertices_get_frame
results.evidence: Active only when the part's node-type field (+0x20) equals 2; uses FUN_004d4810 to get the frame's raw base, then per-vertex-record either interpolates via FUN_004d6b60/FUN_004d6cf0/FUN_004d6e80 or copies raw compressed values via FUN_004d6330, writing plain (non-additive) results into the output buffer.
results.summary: Fills an output vertex buffer with the rotation/translation/scale data for one animation frame of a model part.

results.name: model_vertices_add_frame
results.evidence: Same node-type/flag gating and per-record layout as FUN_004d4dd0 (node-type +0x20==1) but combines results with quaternion_multiply and adds/multiplies into the existing output buffer contents instead of overwriting, matching an additive animation-overlay pattern.
results.summary: Accumulates (additively blends) one animation frame's node transforms onto an existing vertex/transform buffer.

results.name: model_vertices_blend_frame
results.evidence: Identical structure to FUN_004d4f90 but takes an explicit weight parameter used with quaternion_lerp for rotation and linear-weighted addition (val*weight + existing) for translation/scale, i.e. a weighted blend rather than straight overlay.
results.summary: Blends one animation frame's node transforms into an existing buffer using a caller-supplied weight.

results.name: model_vertices_get_interpolated_frame
results.evidence: Uses FUN_00628cca/FUN_00623e40 (fractional-part/round helpers) on a floating-point frame number to derive an integer frame and blend fraction (local_6c), then linearly interpolates rotation/translation/scale between the two adjacent frames' raw or keyframed data via FUN_004d6b60/6cf0/6e80 or manual decompression.
results.summary: Computes vertex/node transform data for a fractional animation frame by interpolating between the two neighboring integer frames.

results.name: model_vertices_blend_interpolated_frame
results.evidence: Same fractional-frame interpolation scaffold as FUN_004d53f0 (FUN_00628cca/FUN_00623e40, adjacent-frame blend) but additionally accepts an external weight parameter and adds/multiplies results into the existing output buffer rather than overwriting.
results.summary: Interpolates between two adjacent animation frames at a fractional frame position and blends the result onto an existing vertex/transform buffer by a given weight.

results.name: model_vertices_bilinear_interpolate_2d_frame
results.evidence: Derives four corner frame indices from a 2D grid (param_1 fields at +8/+0xa/+0x14/+0x16 giving grid dimensions) and two fractional blend weights (fStack_e4/fStack_dc) via FUN_006391b4/FUN_00628cca, then calls FUN_004d6b60/FUN_004d6cf0 at all four corners and bilinearly blends rotation (via chained quaternion_lerp/quaternion_multiply) and translation into the output buffer.
results.summary: Bilinearly interpolates a model part's node transforms across a 2D animation-frame grid (e.g. a 2-axis blend space) using four corner keyframes.

results.name: model_permutation_get_weighted_random_index
results.evidence: Uses a classic LCG (x*0x19660d+0x3c6ef35f) on one of two separate seed globals selected by param_1 to derive a pseudo-random float, then walks a linked list of region/permutation entries (stride 0xb4, next-index at +0x38) comparing against a per-entry probability field at +0x44 until the random draw is satisfied.
results.summary: Picks a weighted-random region/permutation entry using one of two independent RNG streams, walking a linked list of probability-weighted entries.

results.name: model_vertex_decompress_quat
results.evidence: Converts 4 consecutive shorts to floats by multiplying each by 3.051851e-05 (~1/32767), the standard 16-bit-normalized-to-float scale used throughout this cluster for compressed vertex data.
results.summary: Decodes four packed 16-bit fixed-point components (e.g. a quaternion) into floats.

results.name: model_vertex_unpack_compressed_normal
results.evidence: Unpacks three input ushorts into four signed 12-bit fields via bit shifts/masks, converting each to a float scaled by 3.051851e-05 -- the classic Halo 48-bit packed 4x12-bit compressed vector/quaternion format.
results.summary: Unpacks a 48-bit (3x16-bit) compressed 4-component vector/quaternion into four floats.

results.name: model_ik_solve_two_bone
results.evidence: Computes bone lengths via distance formulas between param_2/param_3 translations (+0x28/+0x2c/+0x30) and a target point, applies the law-of-cosines to find the elbow offset along the bone axis, builds a perpendicular basis via cross products, and calls vector3d_normalize_with_length repeatedly to construct the resulting 13-dword (matrix4x3+scale) bone transforms -- the standard two-bone analytic IK solve.
results.summary: Solves a two-bone (e.g. shoulder/elbow or hip/knee) analytic IK chain, computing the middle joint's position and orientation to reach a target.

results.name: model_nodes_calculate_world_transforms
results.evidence: BFS-walks the node hierarchy (child/sibling indices at +0x20/+0x22 of a stride-0x9c node table) calling matrix4x3_from_quaternion on each node's local SQT (stride 0x34 in param_1) and multiplying it by the parent's already-computed world matrix via the matrix4x3_multiply function pointer, writing results back into the same 0x34-stride array.
results.summary: Converts an array of per-node local SQT transforms into node-hierarchy world-space matrices by traversing the node tree.

results.name: model_nodes_blend_transforms
results.evidence: Computes a weight t=(param_2+1)/param_3, then for each 8-float SQT node-transform record (rotation quaternion + translation + scale, matching the layout used elsewhere) linearly blends scale/translation and slerp-blends rotation via quaternion_lerp/quaternion_normalize between two input arrays.
results.summary: Blends two arrays of node SQT transforms together by a weight fraction, slerping rotations and lerping translation/scale.

results.name: model_get_region_index_by_name
results.evidence: Linearly scans the model's region array (datum+0x14 -> count at +0x74, entries at +0x78, stride 0xb4) using __stricmp on each entry's name field against the input string, returning the matching index or -1.
results.summary: Looks up a model region's index by comparing its name against every region in the model definition.

results.name: model_keyframe_time_lower_bound
results.evidence: Classic binary search over a sorted short array (param_1) of length in_EAX for a target value (unaff_BX), returning the insertion index -- used by the keyframe interpolators FUN_004d6b60/FUN_004d6cf0/FUN_004d6e80.
results.summary: Binary-searches a sorted array of keyframe time values for the position of a target value.

results.name: model_node_get_interpolated_rotation
results.evidence: Rounds a float frame number (via FUN_00623e40), binary-searches keyframe times with FUN_004d6b10, decompresses the surrounding keyframes with FUN_004d6380, and slerps between them via quaternion_lerp/quaternion_normalize when the exact frame isn't a keyframe.
results.summary: Evaluates a node's compressed rotation animation curve at a given frame, interpolating between keyframes as needed.

results.name: model_node_get_interpolated_translation
results.evidence: Same keyframe-array/binary-search pattern as FUN_004d6b60 (via FUN_004d6b10 and FUN_00623e40) but linearly interpolates a 3-float translation between two surrounding keyframe control points instead of slerping a quaternion.
results.summary: Evaluates a node's translation animation curve at a given frame, linearly interpolating between keyframe control points.

results.name: model_node_get_interpolated_scale
results.evidence: Same keyframe-array/binary-search pattern as FUN_004d6b60/FUN_004d6cf0 (via FUN_004d6b10 and FUN_00623e40) but interpolates a single scale float between two surrounding keyframes.
results.summary: Evaluates a node's scale animation curve at a given frame, linearly interpolating between keyframe control points.

results.name: model_render_draw
results.evidence: Builds per-node world matrices (matrix4x3_multiply against puVar1[0x2f]), selects a LOD level by comparing param_1 (a distance-like metric) against per-LOD thresholds at puVar1[2..6] with an override via DAT_006893e8, configures render flags from the model definition and caller bits, optionally calls chimera__rasterizer_set_model_skinning, then delegates to FUN_004d72a0 to build the node-part draw list and FUN_0052b530 to submit it.
results.summary: Top-level model rendering entry point: computes node world matrices, selects a level of detail, and drives node-part drawing.

results.name: model_render_build_node_part_commands
results.evidence: Iterates the model's region/permutation table (param_1+0xc4) and, per node part entry, dispatches by a shader/part-type field (+0x24) to chimera__rasterizer_set_up_node_parts, FUN_0052b050, or FUN_00531350 depending on part type and a two-pass (sVar8) opaque/decal scheme, matching FUN_004d6fc0's caller usage as its node-part draw-list builder.
results.summary: Builds the list of per-node-part draw/shader-setup calls for rendering a model, iterating regions/permutations and part types across an opaque/decal pass.

results.name: model_nodes_get_default_transforms
results.evidence: For each of the object's nodes (unaff_ESI+0xb8 count, stride 0x9c source table) copies the quaternion (+0x34..+0x40) and translation (+0x28..+0x30) directly into an 8-float, 0x20-stride output array and sets the 8th field (scale) to 1.0 -- the canonical unanimated base-pose SQT node transform.
results.summary: Copies each node's default (unanimated) rotation and translation into an SQT transform array with scale fixed at 1.0.

results.name: model_nodes_calculate_world_transforms_with_root_override
results.evidence: Nearly identical BFS node-hierarchy traversal and matrix4x3_from_quaternion/matrix4x3_multiply combination as FUN_004d6880, but seeds the root node's local quaternion from an explicit input pointer (in_EAX) rather than the node table's own stored local pose, suggesting a variant used to override the root transform (e.g. for an attached/child object).
results.summary: Computes node-hierarchy world-space transforms like FUN_004d6880, but takes the root node's local rotation from an external override rather than the model's own base pose.

results.name: model_marker_group_index_from_name
results.evidence: Binary-searches a sorted array (datum+0xb0, count at +0xac, stride 0x40) using __stricmp on each entry's name, returning the matching index or 0xffff -- distinct stride/sorted-search pattern from the linear region-name lookup in FUN_004d6ab0, consistent with a sorted marker-group name table.
results.summary: Looks up a marker group's index within a model definition by binary-searching its sorted name table.

results.name: model_markers_get_by_name
results.evidence: Calls FUN_004d77c0 to resolve a marker group by name, then iterates that group's marker instances (count/array at the resolved entry's +0x34/+0x38), optionally remapping each instance's permutation index through param_2, and for each instance calls matrix4x3_from_quaternion plus matrix4x3_multiply against the node world transforms in param_3 to produce world-space marker transforms in the output buffer.
results.summary: Resolves a marker group by name and returns the world-space transforms of all its marker instances for the current node poses.
